title: Cantonese language
at_a_glance: Native names: 广州话 [廣州話] (Gwóngdūng wá) [kʷɔŋ˧˥ tʊŋ˥ wa˧˥] 广东话 [廣東話] (Gwóngjāu wá) [kʷɔŋ˧˥ ʦɐu˥ wa˧˥] 粤语 [粵語] (Yuhtyúh) [jyːt̚˧˥ ju˧˥]
Linguistic affliation: Sino-Tibetan, Sinitic, Yue, Yuehai
Spoken in: China, USA, Malaysia, Canada, Vietnam, Australia, Singapore and Indonesia
